items.title: 61125_Teddy Bunn oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] [Deak.] Yeah. I wondered why they didn't like they did. stay together, but they didn't.

ctx.x: [Deak.] Yeah. I wondered why they didn't like they did. stay together, but they didn't. It's a shame. Most of them's gone now.
Uh-huh. I wanted to try and go back again, back to the '30s, and talk about some of the different people you worked with.
